---
title: "Count models"
---

Count outcomes are where quantile residuals become especially helpful: ordinary residuals often show bands because the response is discrete. `qresid` uses Dunn-Smyth randomization inside the CDF jump.

```stata
clear
set obs 150
set seed 20260510
generate double x = rnormal()
generate double mu = exp(.2 + .5*x)
generate int y = rpoisson(mu)
poisson y x
qresid rq_pois, seed(101)
qnorm rq_pois
predict double n_pois, n
scatter rq_pois n_pois, yline(0)
```

For teaching, compare Poisson, negative binomial, zero-inflated, truncated, censored, generalized Poisson, and hurdle routes on the same synthetic or applied dataset when the support matrix marks them ready.
